data.description:
# Bootstrap Phaser + TypeScript project scaffold

## Problem statement

The AI_Hell repository currently contains only documentation (`docs/Game Design Document.md`, `README.md`) and worklog tooling — no game code, no `package.json`, no build system. Every subsequent implementation item (starting with the gym scene) needs a runnable Phaser v3 + TypeScript project as its foundation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1 — A `package.json` exists with `phaser` v3 as the game engine dependency and `typescript` as the language, plus `npm run dev` / `npm run build` scripts (Vite recommended, matching the GDD §6.3 web distribution model).
- [ ] AC2 — TypeScript configuration and a Vite/HTML entry point exist so `npm run dev` launches a browser window rendering a Phaser game; `npm run build` produces a deployable bundle.
- [ ] AC3 — The source tree follows the GDD §6.4 module layout (`src/core/Game.ts` boot/entry point, `src/entities/`, etc.) at least for the bootstrapped parts.
- [ ] AC4 — A minimal runnable Phaser scene (e.g., blank `BootScene` or empty `MainScene`) verifies the framework initializes (canvas renders, game loop ticks) — no gameplay mechanics yet.
- [ ] AC5 — A test runner is configured (e.g., Vitest) with at least one trivial passing test to verify the harness works.
- [ ] AC6 — All related documentation is updated to reflect the new scaffold (README gains a "Run the game" section with install/dev/build/test commands).
- [ ] AC7 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MT7UY5UR002LD5U** – Redesign P7 Dash: make collectable teleport power-up (completed)
- **AH-0MT7QQGFD006E6TL** – Update README to reference GDD (completed)
- **AH-0MT7VE4SX0005A8V** – Add a Magnet power up (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — matched: ac1, ac2, ac3, ac4, ac5 (+63 more)
- `README.md` — matched: acceptance, build, changes, code, configuration (+58 more)
- `AGENTS.md` — matched: acceptance, build, changes, code, commands (+38 more)

Auto-plan completed with review: effort (Small) and risk (Low) are below the planning threshold, so no decomposition into child items is required. Review summary:
- Requirements & AC alignment: all 7 ACs trace back to the problem statement and GDD §6.3/§6.4; no missing, contradictory, or invented ACs.
- Completeness: description, problem statement, and 7 ACs present; no Key Files section to validate; children not needed for a Small/Low task.
- Sequencing & dependencies: no children exist, no dependency edges to verify; single unit of work.
- Scope sizing: Small effort (4.17h expected, 4.5-9.5h range) — deliverable as one increment; no vertical-slice phasing required.
- Acceptance & testability: every AC is binary pass/fail and objectively verifiable (file/dependency checks, build success, dev launch, npm test).
- Polish & handoff: clear, well-formatted, actionable description with related-work context and an on-record effort/risk estimate.
- AC coverage review: recommendation 'proceed' — 100% parent AC coverage, no unresolved conflicts, no auto-close gaps.
No content changes were made (no unambiguous gaps found). Ready for direct implementation (planned toolchain: Vite + TypeScript + Phaser v3, Vitest).
